newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 6.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 6.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:

* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones industrial average jumped 143.29 points, or 2.0 percent, to 7,214.49, beating the old mark of 7,085.16 set on March 11 and its 16th record so far this year, on hopes that a balanced federal budget deal would keep the Federal Reserve from raising interest rates later this month.
* Canadian gold prospector Bre-X Minerals said on Sunday that an independent report concluded that the company's claims for the Busang gold discovery in Indonesia were based on falsified data.
* On Monday, the composite index rose 4.89 points to close at 652.79 points.
* On Tuesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,424.50/25.00 at 0135 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,424.50/25.50.
* Small chemical firm Duta Pertiwi Nusantara on market talk of a possible rights issue, business diversification and a stock split.
* Small property firm Elang Realty following announcement of poor 1996 financial results and a link-up with retailer PT Gelael.
* Food company Sierad Produce on market talk that a Malaysian business tycoon was expected to buy a large stake in the firm.
* Property firm Bhuwanatala on a newspaper report it was expected to acquire five properties in Jakarta, Surabaya and Semarang and that it was expected to list a subsidiary.
